sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==QA Automation Engineer== with 6+ years of experience ==designing, developing, and maintaining automated test scripts== for web applications. ==Automated 270+ regression test cases== using BrowserStack LCNC and ACCELQ and developed Selenium WebDriver automation for critical workflows. ==Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps for CI/CD and defect management==, with ==SQL-based data validation== and exposure to Python and generative AI applied to software testing. ==Collaborates with cross-functional teams to identify requirements, create comprehensive test plans and ensure high-quality deliverables== through QA best practices and industry standards. Experienced across SaaS, CRM, e-commerce, web and mobile platforms.
